key_insight: A modular automated X-ray inspection system combines servo positioning and structurally verified mechanics to inspect pipe welds with ±1 mm positioning accuracy.
engineering_relevance: The design supports industrial weld inspection for pipes 40–508 mm in diameter and 6–12 m long, with internal or external inspection depending on pipe diameter.
method: Surveyed plant layout and overhead-crane feeding requirements.
Integrated rail-guided transport, servo positioning, laser verification, and height adjustment for imaging at 25 cm intervals.
Performed finite element structural analysis and experimental testing on the manufactured system.
evidence_signal: Reported maximum stresses were 133.5 MPa in the arm and 211.1 MPa in the rail vehicle, with respective safety factors of 3.1 and 1.96; experimental tests validated simulation results.
watch_item: The abstract does not quantify defect-detection performance or experimental agreement with simulations.
paper_title: Design and Validation of an Automated X-Ray Imaging System for Pipe Weld Inspection
